queries.name: System Identity
queries.desc: Hostname, UUID, CPU, RAM, hardware vendor
queries.sql: SELECT hostname, uuid, cpu_brand, cpu_physical_cores, cpu_logical_cores, ROUND(physical_memory/1073741824.0,2) AS memory_gb, hardware_vendor, hardware_model FROM system_info;

queries.name: OS Version
queries.sql: SELECT name, version, major, minor, patch, arch, platform FROM os_version;

queries.name: Kernel Info
queries.sql: SELECT version, arguments, path FROM kernel_info;

queries.name: System Uptime
queries.desc: How long the system has been running
queries.sql: SELECT days, hours, minutes, total_seconds FROM uptime;

queries.name: Human User Accounts
queries.sql: SELECT uid, gid, username, directory, shell FROM users WHERE uid >= 1000 ORDER BY uid;

queries.name: System Accounts
queries.sql: SELECT uid, username, shell, description FROM users WHERE uid < 1000 ORDER BY uid;

queries.name: Root Equivalent Accounts
queries.desc: Accounts with UID 0 — should only be root
queries.sql: SELECT username, uid, gid, shell, directory FROM users WHERE uid = 0;

queries.name: Privileged Group Members
queries.desc: Users in sudo, docker, shadow, adm groups
queries.sql: SELECT users.username, users.uid, groups.groupname FROM user_groups JOIN users ON user_groups.uid = users.uid JOIN groups ON user_groups.gid = groups.gid WHERE groups.groupname IN ('sudo','docker','shadow','adm','wheel') ORDER BY groups.groupname, users.username;

queries.name: Currently Logged In Users
queries.sql: SELECT user, tty, host, pid, datetime(time,'unixepoch') AS login_time FROM logged_in_users WHERE type = 'user' ORDER BY time DESC;

queries.name: Login History (Last 24h)
queries.desc: All logins in the last 24 hours
queries.sql: SELECT username, tty, host, datetime(time,'unixepoch') AS login_time FROM last WHERE username != '' AND username != 'reboot' AND time > (strftime('%s','now') - 86400) ORDER BY time DESC;

queries.name: Remote SSH Logins
queries.sql: SELECT username, host, tty, datetime(time,'unixepoch') AS login_time FROM last WHERE host != '' AND host != ':0' AND host NOT LIKE 'localhost%' AND username != '' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20;

queries.name: Network Interfaces
queries.desc: All network interfaces with IPv4 addresses
queries.sql: SELECT interface, address, mask FROM interface_addresses WHERE address NOT LIKE '%:%' ORDER BY interface;

queries.name: MAC Addresses
queries.desc: MAC address of each network interface
queries.sql: SELECT name, mac, type FROM interface_details WHERE mac != '' ORDER BY name;

queries.name: Default Gateway
queries.sql: SELECT gateway, interface FROM routes WHERE destination = '0.0.0.0' AND netmask = '0' ORDER BY metric ASC LIMIT 1;

queries.name: DNS Resolvers
queries.sql: SELECT type, address FROM dns_resolvers WHERE type = 'nameserver';

queries.name: Disk Mounts
queries.sql: SELECT path, device, type, ROUND(100.0-(blocks_free*100.0/blocks),1) AS percent_used FROM mounts WHERE blocks > 0 AND type NOT IN ('tmpfs','devtmpfs','proc','sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2') ORDER BY path;

queries.name: Disk Encryption Status
queries.desc: Encryption status of all block devices
queries.sql: SELECT name, uuid, encrypted, type, encryption_status FROM disk_encryption ORDER BY name;

queries.name: Installed Packages Count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_packages FROM deb_packages;

queries.name: Kernel Modules
queries.sql: SELECT name, size, status FROM kernel_modules ORDER BY name LIMIT 30;

queries.name: Shell History Summary
queries.desc: Command count per user in shell history
queries.sql: SELECT username, COUNT(*) AS command_count FROM shell_history GROUP BY username ORDER BY command_count DESC;
